item.title: KnowYou v1.2.7 (377)
item.description:
KnowYou 1.2.7 makes global search faster and more reliable.
What is new: - Global Search now uses a local persistent index for Diary, Sources, Todo, and My Wiki, so repeated searches no longer rescan local files. - Search opens from the main navigation and Command-F, keeps explicit Search/Enter submit behavior, and shows separate local indexing/searching states. - Search results continue to support highlighting and navigation while avoiding silent drops during first-time indexing.
Release details: - Version: 1.2.7 - Released: 2026-06-10
